description: Find verified local tradespeople in the UK on Energy North (electricians, plumbers, gas engineers, roofers, builders, cleaners and 80+ trades). Give the trade and the town or city; returns the Energy North page for that trade and place, the services covered, and the link to post a job.

city.description: UK town or city, e.g. "London", "Newcastle upon Tyne", "Leeds". Leave empty for all of the UK.

trade.description: The trade or job in plain words, e.g. "electrician", "boiler repair", "roofer", "EV charger".

name: find_tradespeople
title: Find local tradespeople
